name: Collapsible sidebar
description: A sidebar that rests as a strip of icons and opens to full width while the pointer or keyboard focus is in it.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sidebar shows its full width (controlled). On small screens this is the sheet.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when hover, focus or the menu button opens or closes it.

props.name: defaultPinned
props.description: Start pinned: kept open at full width, taking its space in the layout.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: logo
props.description: A mark of about 32 pixels, shown in the icon column and in the top bar on small screens.

props.name: name
props.description: The product name beside the logo, shown when open.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the aside landmark.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarBody, then optionally SidebarFooter.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the aside. Also accepts every other aside attribute.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the navigation landmark that holds the links.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarLink elements. The list scrolls when it is taller than the space.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes.

props.name: icon
props.description: An 18 pixel icon, the only thing visible while collapsed.

props.name: label
props.description: The text that slides in beside the icon. It is always the link's accessible name.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the current page with aria-current and the water bar, which slides here from the previous current link.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called on click. On small screens the sheet closes afterwards. Also accepts every other anchor attribute.

props.name: avatar
props.description: An image URL, drawn as a 32 pixel circle, or your own element.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name.

props.name: detail
props.description: A second, muted line such as a role or email.

props.name: children
props.description: An optional control at the end of the row, shown when open.
